title: Coherent Corp. Announces Timing of Second-Quarter Fiscal 2025 Earnings Release
summary: Jan. 22, 2025. Coherent will release second-quarter fiscal 2025 financial results on Wednesday, February 5, after the New York Stock Exchange closes.
body_markdown:
PITTSBURGH, Jan. 22, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) –[Coherent Corp.](https://www.coherent.com/) (NYSE: COHR) (the “Company”), a global leader in materials, networking, and lasers, announced today that it will release second-quarter fiscal 2025 financial results on Wednesday, February 5, after the New York Stock Exchange closes. The release will be followed by a live audio webcast at 5:00 p.m. ET to discuss the results.


The Company invites investors to join the live audio webcast at[coherent.com/company/ investor-relations/financial-webcasts](https://www.coherent.com/company/investor-relations/financial-webcasts) . The webcast will be recorded, and a replay will be available within 24 hours after the live audio webcast on the company’s website.


Media Contact **:**


Amy Wilson


corporate.communications@coherent.com
